company.name: Paymob
company.shortDescription: Paymob is a digital payments enabler for emerging markets, helping small and large enterprises accept payments online and in-store.
company.description:
Paymob is a regional digital payments enabler that builds payments infrastructue technologies empowering the underserved with access to financial services. Paymob is bridging the financial inclusion gap in MEA region by enabling businesses of all sizes to benefit from the power of digital payments and what it unlocks. 

Paymob was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $22,000,000, or 24.31% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,432,880 to $255,005,401, a 18.98x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
